name: fung
about: 馮 (Fung, the Cantonese spelling of the surname) as a neon sign, a still for the user, 2026-09-29: 冫 (two dots) and 馬 (horse). No small line: none we could stand behind. In Make Me a Hanzi's data strokes 0-1 are 冫 and 2-11 馬; a clip traces 2-11 then 0-1 ("order").

music.why: The Receptive's track (Analog Dreams, 90 bpm), the user's favourite of the first shorts; calm, for a sign that draws itself in
